instruction: Initialize an LDAP directory with a base domain entry
output:
cat > /tmp/base.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: dcObject
objectClass: organization
objectClass: top
dc: example
o: Example Inc.
EOF
ldapadd -x -D cn=admin,cn=config -w secret -f /tmp/base.ldif

instruction: Create an organizational unit for users in LDAP
output:
cat > /tmp/ou.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: ou=people,dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: organizationalUnit
ou: people
EOF
ldapadd -x -D cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com -w secret -f /tmp/ou.ldif

instruction: Create a typical LDAP posixAccount and inetOrgPerson entry
output:
cat > /tmp/user.ldif << 'EOF'
dn: uid=jdoe,ou=people,dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: top
objectClass: person
objectClass: organizationalPerson
objectClass: inetOrgPerson
objectClass: posixAccount
cn: John Doe
sn: Doe
uid: jdoe
uidNumber: 1001
gidNumber: 1001
homeDirectory: /home/jdoe
loginShell: /bin/bash
mail: jdoe@example.com
userPassword: {SSHA}hash
EOF
ldapadd -x -D cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com -W -f /tmp/user.ldif

instruction: Set up an LDAP replica with an updated referral
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcUpdateref
olcUpdateref: ldap://master.example.com'

instruction: Configure OpenLDAP to use LMDB instead of MDB
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDatabase
olcDatabase: {1}ldif'

instruction: Change the MDB database environment flags
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDbEnvFlags
olcDbEnvFlags: nometasync'

instruction: Set the MDB map size
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDbMaxSize
olcDbMaxSize: 1073741824'

instruction: Set MDB database to use 256MB of cache
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDbCacheSize
olcDbCacheSize: 268435456'

instruction: Set the number of MDB database reader slots
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcDbMaxReaders
olcDbMaxReaders: 256'
